intro: If you have business around Lam Luk Ka-Khlong Luang, you're visiting family near Bueng Kham Phroi, or you simply want a room with a little kitchen for a longer stay — The Seasons is a small aparthotel that many guests end up liking for its quiet. It's an apartment-style property of just around 9 units, open since about 2016, in Bueng Kham Phroi, Lam Luk Ka. Rooms come with a fridge, dining table, sofa and balcony, there's free parking, and rates start at about ฿790/night — an easy budget pick for anyone staying a few days in the area.

body.html: The first thing that sets The Seasons apart from a typical roadside hotel is that it's a very small apartment-style property — only around 9 units. There's no big lobby and no constant flow of people, so it feels quieter and more private than a mid-size hotel. It sits in Bueng Kham Phroi, Lam Luk Ka, on the side that borders northern Bangkok (the Sai Mai-Nong Chok zone), which makes it handy for errands on both the Lam Luk Ka side and the northern Bangkok side.

The feature longer-stay guests like most is that rooms have a small kitchen and a fridge. Each unit is set up like an apartment, with a dining table, sofa, work desk, TV and a private balcony. If you're staying several nights and tire of eating out every meal, you can buy groceries and cook in the room. Rooms are a good size, beds are comfortable, and some have blackout curtains that help you sleep through the day. The reviews that exist agree the rooms are clean and the basics are all there.

Free on-site parking is reassuring for anyone driving, since this is a suburban area where you really need a car. There's free Wi-Fi and an on-site restaurant too. Staff and the security guard get warm mentions for being kind and helpful — one review specifically called out "the security guard was very kind," a small touch that makes a small property like this feel welcoming. There are local markets and eateries nearby for finding a meal.
"Clean, spacious room with a little kitchen and a fridge inside — really comfortable for a multi-day stay. The security guard was very kind, parking is free, and it's nice and quiet."

To be straight with you, The Seasons is small and still fairly new, so the review count is thin. Only a handful of guests have rated it on the booking platforms, so the scores you see reflect a small group rather than an average from hundreds of stays like a big hotel. If you want a large pile of reviews before booking, keep that in mind. But for an apartment-style room in the budget range, the feedback that exists leans positive on cleanliness and quiet.

Two things worth checking first are the suburban location and that some stays are most convenient to pay in cash. The property is down a lane in Bueng Kham Phroi, not on a main road or near a rail line, so without your own car you'll rely on Grab. There are reports that cash is the smoothest way to pay at times, so bring cash and confirm payment methods with the property before you arrive. It's about 11 km from Don Mueang Airport, and Dream World and Safari World are a short drive away.

Overall, The Seasons suits people with errands around Lam Luk Ka-Khlong Luang, or anyone wanting a kitchen room for a longer budget stay more than a tourist who needs everything within walking distance. Rates start around ฿790 and rise with room type and season into the low thousands. Judged on quiet, clean rooms with a kitchen, and free parking, it does the job of a suburban aparthotel nicely at a price that's easy on the wallet.
